verses.text: People of Israel, listen to this message the LORD has spoken against you, against the whole family he brought up out of Egypt:
"Of all the families on earth, you are the only one I have chosen. That is why I will punish you for all your sins."
Do two people walk together unless they have agreed to meet?
Does a lion roar in the forest when it has no prey? Does a young lion growl in its den when it has caught nothing?
Does a bird fall into a trap on the ground when no bait has been set? Does a trap spring shut when there is nothing to catch?
When a trumpet sounds a warning in a city, aren't the people afraid? When disaster comes to a city, hasn't the LORD caused it?
The Lord GOD does nothing without revealing his plans to his servants the prophets.
The lion has roared. Who will not be afraid? The Lord GOD has spoken. Who can keep from prophesying?
Announce this to the fortresses of Ashdod and to the fortresses of Egypt: "Gather on the mountains of Samaria. See the great unrest within her and the oppression among her people."
"They do not know how to do what is right," says the LORD. "They store up in their fortresses what they have taken by violence and robbery."
So this is what the Lord GOD says: "An enemy will surround the land. He will pull down your strongholds and rob your fortresses."

This is what the LORD says: "A shepherd may rescue only two leg bones or a piece of an ear from a lion's mouth. In the same way, only a few of the people of Israel who live in Samaria will be rescued, those who sit in the corner of a couch or on silk cushions of a bed."
"Listen to this and testify against the family of Jacob," says the Lord GOD, the God of Armies.
"On the day I punish Israel for their sins, I will also destroy the altars of Bethel. The horns of the altar will be cut off and fall to the ground.
I will tear down the winter house along with the summer house. The houses decorated with ivory will be destroyed, and the great houses will come to an end," says the LORD.
